artifact_scope: Historical audit only; units are grouped canonical experiment families/stages, not independent-study counts.
method: Read existing published result/summary Markdown and targeted audit reports; no raw patient or generated-row tables, no target reruns, no web retrieval, no edits to prior artifacts. Numeric support reproduces report values/rounding.

coverage.scope: All top-level M1/M2/M3–17 reports including A/B/C variants and M9 preparation; relevant dated2026-10-25–28 parent directories; nested framework Stage1 and uncertainty follow-up included.
exclusions: Raw source records, generated patient rows, original full-text source documents
Later experiment families delegated to sibling audits

grade_definitions.A: Strongest available historical support for a bounded analytical use on a reserved measured reference; still exploratory and not equivalence/superiority.
grade_definitions.B: Specific positive empirical or diagnostic finding with mixed utility or exposed-development limitations.
grade_definitions.C: Supplied-constraint reconstruction or source-only feasibility, not independent target validity.
grade_definitions.E: Engineering/constructed demonstration; no biomedical efficacy result.
grade_definitions.R: Review, preparation or governance only; no new empirical generation validation.

global_guards: Do not sum participants across reused NHANES cycles/endpoints or Ross/Travers/He replays as independent cohorts.
Draws, lifecycle versions, endpoints, source checks and unit tests are not studies or independent Agent constructions.
Mean-change recovery can be implied by supplied pre/post means; paired dispersion and joint dependence remain separate.
HOMA and other derived outcomes do not establish recovery of each underlying biological component.
Input regimes differ: whole-cohort summaries, observed-covariate enrichment and observed-data-conditioned completion must stay separate.
An entire withheld column is unmeasured for the builder; output is not the person's recovered true measurement.
Published equations or deliberately imposed shape are transferred assumptions, not novel biological discoveries.
Reported generation ranges are not calibrated source/structural/transport uncertainty; reference CIs do not prove synthetic equivalence.
Fresh-context/procedural boundaries and local hashes do not rule out unlogged access or model pretraining knowledge.
Source/reference summaries disclosed for reconstruction cannot count as reserved scientific successes.
Literal row authorship and Agent-authored stochastic programs are both real routes and must not be conflated.
Existing references/candidate bytes remain unchanged in this audit.

priority_findings.claim: Selected downstream analytical utility exists across both enrichment and evidence-only whole-cohort modes.
priority_findings.limit: Relationships are partly evidence-supported/assumed; effects, interactions and distributional fidelity remain mixed; no general replacement or method superiority.

priority_findings.claim: True literal tables can support a useful later-sample prediction task and selected association analyses.
priority_findings.limit: Temporal prediction consumes rich outcome-conditioned realtraining summaries; direct urate results are one finite reference per unit; no patient reconstruction, cost saving or stable superiority.

priority_findings.claim: The archive demonstrates concrete reconstruction, preservation and local repair capabilities that are narrower than general efficacy.
priority_findings.limit: Disclosed constraints, unchanged-cell controls and reused data must be labeled; better cell recovery or source matching does not guarantee better downstream analysis.

temporal_prediction_detail.task: Classify concurrent laboratory HbA1c>=5.7% in adults20–79 with BMI>=30; no future disease claim. BMI selects the population and is a predictor, but does not define the HbA1c outcome.
predictors: mean available positive auscultatory systolic BP
temporal_prediction_detail.source_summary_origin: Freshly computed from one fixed seeded128-record sample of1870 eligible NHANES2015–16 records. Other1742 did not inform fitting/tuning/summary estimation. Four label-by-sex strata include counts, moments, seven quantiles and regularized Gaussian-rank correlations.
temporal_prediction_detail.authorship: Two fresh Agents literally authored128 rows each; unchanged initial round0 outputs; no code execution, source browsing, numerical/performance feedback or repair requested. Root schema/provenance fixes preceded lock; no scientific row alteration reported.
temporal_prediction_detail.locked_models: 103cohorts ×2 fixed families=206 fitted models; prevalence reference additional. Logistic StandardScaler uses own128row training set, C=1/L2/lbfgs/max_iter2000. Small HistGradientBoosting fixed with early stopping disabled. Threshold0.5 fixed.
temporal_prediction_detail.chronology: Recorded models freeze2026-10-25T16:14:21.403253+00:00; test acquisition manifest2026-10-25T16:14:27.086833+00:00. Zero ID overlap. No feature/hyperparameter/family selection or test-derived calibration. Local provenance cannot prove absence of unlogged access.

ordinary_generation_quantiles.interpretation: 2.5–97.5 percentiles across100 synthetic training draws; not sampling CIs

temporal_prediction_detail.verification: Existing independent audit reports207 prediction vectors/206 model schemas/323locked artifact hashes verified, numerical difference<=1.33e-15; all scalers matched owntraining data; no correction needed. Current audit did not rerun.
temporal_prediction_detail.limits: Two direct authors, one realtraining draw, one later cycle. No inferential sampling CIs, equivalence or noninferiority test. Same survey, complete-case selection, no medication adjustment, secondary-assay change; weighted metrics descriptive. Seven retainedwomen20–44 had unknown pregnancy status under frozen exclude-recorded-pregnancy rule. Test documentation exposed ancillary assay/specimen information but not test outcome/predictor distributions.

units.input_setting: Clinical group summaries supplied; IL-6 and TNF-alpha group summaries withheld; known paper identifiable.
units.actual_scale: One 27-person pediatric source; two fresh direct 27-row constructions.
units.comparison: Authored group moments versus published moments.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Both literal cohorts preserved higher IL-6 and TNF-alpha in MUO than MHO.
units.numeric_support: Paper contrasts 1.10/1.10; A 0.75/0.56; B 0.54/0.54. Supplied clinical mean median errors 0.05/0.07 source SD.
units.counterresults: All withheld contrasts attenuated; generated clinical SDs as low as 0.26 of supplied SD.
units.inference_scope: Prompt withholding does not exclude pretraining exposure; published-summary consistency, not independent patient validation.
units.paper_role: Early feasibility illustration; do not use as independent discovery.

units.input_setting: Study design, units, n=12 and pre/post means/sample SDs rounded to3 decimals, freshly computed from public workbook rather than all printed in article; no paired correlations/change SD/CI/p-values or patient rows.
units.actual_scale: One 12-man, three-day intervention cohort; two direct 12-person paired cohorts; four endpoints.
units.comparison: Same original paired analyses on measured and generated tables.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Both constructions retained all four change directions and unadjusted significance classifications; one closely reconstructed leptin change variability.
units.numeric_support: Leptin real change/SD -2.563/1.534; B -2.567/1.541; paired p 0.0001212 versus 0.0001244.
units.counterresults: A underestimates change dispersion materially; B underestimates three of four endpoint dispersions.
units.inference_scope: Within-study reconstruction with disclosed margins and very small male-only sample; p agreement partly input constrained.
units.paper_role: Concrete true-direct-row precedent; supplementary reconstruction example.

units.input_setting: Same disclosed pre/post marginal moments for direct authors and ordinary paired Gaussian-copula sampler.
units.actual_scale: 44 pediatric completers; glucose/TG 43 pairs; two direct constructions; 3,000 ordinary draws across three rho settings.
units.comparison: Direct rows versus primary rho=0.5 sampler and sensitivity rho=0/0.9.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Direct rows closely reconstructed margins and body-mass paired dispersion better than the primary fixed-rho comparator.
units.numeric_support: Body-mass SD(change)/real: A 0.823, B 0.705, ordinary median 6.277.
units.counterresults: Ordinary comparator closer for three other paired dispersions; both direct cohorts made TG significant when measured data were nonsignificant (p 0.4014 vs 0.04359/0.02300).
units.inference_scope: One modest source; unknown paired dependence dominates; no consistent direct-author advantage.
units.paper_role: Counterweight to selected reconstruction successes.

units.input_setting: He source margins plus newly disclosed within-endpoint pre/post correlations; cross-endpoint relations withheld.
units.actual_scale: Same 44/43-pair source; two fresh direct authors; one tool planner; 1,000 ordinary draws; unchanged retained direct tables.
units.comparison: Direct supplied-constraint reconstruction versus ordinary/tool sampling; post-hoc 18 cross-endpoint edges.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Explicit dependence evidence enables literal rows to reconstruct paired variability very closely.
units.numeric_support: Direct change-SD/packet ratios: D1 0.9784–1.0036; D2 0.9857–1.0099. Tool planner outputs exactly equal ordinary same-seed rows.
units.counterresults: No numerical revision occurred. Cross-endpoint rMAE D1 0.4212, D2 0.3292 versus ordinary 0.1903/0.2236.
units.inference_scope: Supplied correlations mathematically determine paired dispersion; not hidden-outcome recovery or new clinical replication. Review demo reuses H03 data and creates no new Agent run.
units.paper_role: Mechanistic illustration of what evidence buys; avoid treating p-value reconstruction as independent validation.

units.input_setting: Outcome-by-sex-stratified counts, means, SDs, seven quantiles and regularized rank correlations from 128 real NHANES 2015–16 participants; no individual author inputs.
units.actual_scale: 128 real training rows; two literal 128-row cohorts; 100 ordinary cohorts; 1,811 eligible NHANES 2017–18 test participants; two frozen classifiers.
units.comparison: Real-only training and information-matched ordinary generation, no favorable-seed selection.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Aggregate-conditioned literal synthetic rows retained useful discrimination for current elevated HbA1c in a later survey cycle.
units.numeric_support: Logistic AUC: real 0.734936; A1 0.712130; A2 0.726871; ordinary median 0.717394. Brier: real 0.210303; A1 0.216229; A2 0.213445; ordinary 0.215560. Prevalence-only AUC0.5/Brier0.248578. Ordinary AUC generation quantiles0.651048–0.743380; A1/A2 exceed38/67 of100 draws. Weighted logistic AUC real0.742122/A1 0.722713/A2 0.734453/ordinary0.724310.
units.counterresults: Neither author surpassed real-only AUC/Brier; one author below and one above ordinary AUC median. Both inside ordinary generation interval; no sampling CIs or noninferiority testing; boosting AUC real0.660930/A1 0.634484/A2 0.646883/ordinary0.638858 and Brier0.240598/0.247879/0.242525/0.261487.
units.inference_scope: Cross-cycle within same survey, current measured threshold not future diabetes; summaries used measured outcome labels; one training draw and two authors; no feedback intervention. Raw HbA1c excluded from five predictors. Training-only StandardScaler; threshold0.5 and both classifier families fixed. Model lock16:14:21.403UTC precedes test download16:14:27.087. Original round0 direct outputs unchanged; only prelock schema/provenance fixes. No formal guarantee against unlogged/pretraining exposure.
units.paper_role: Strong historical downstream-use example; explicitly summary-conditioned and non-superiority.

units.input_setting: Source-summary packets computed from public individual data, not automatically extracted paper tables; no target outcome summaries; forecasts frozen.
units.actual_scale: Population NAGALA n=15,450; intervention DIETFITS n=464; three Agent contexts per arm; three queries per case.
units.comparison: Direct Agent A versus cohort Agent B versus random-effects C; source-specific references.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Both Agent arms improved primary association point loss over exchangeable pooling in both cases.
units.numeric_support: Equal-case primary squared error A 0.001137; B 0.001500; C 0.006246. Population target r 0.3469; B forecasts 0.3291–0.3373.
units.counterresults: B did not beat A; C better all-query equal-case error (0.004286 vs A 0.005205/B 0.005434); evaluator sex-code repair disclosed.
units.inference_scope: Only two cases; primary forecasts not necessarily reusable-row superiority; source relevance varies by query; targets now exposed.
units.paper_role: Support for contextual evidence use, not necessity of a virtual cohort representation.

units.input_setting: WLM/STRRIDE-PD aggregates; target baseline sex/TG summaries; sequential DIETFITS development feedback.

units.classification: direct/program development comparison with post-hoc utility replay
units.input_setting: Same target-derived margins for two fresh authors; external PFS–DD100 relation; no patient rows or query answers.
units.actual_scale: 75 trajectories, five visits, 1,875 slots; one literal author with 288-cell revision; one program; three unique cohorts despite four lifecycle labels.

units.input_setting: Visible observations condition both imputers; one external correlation explicitly not numerically used. Agent sees only first masked input before generic method freeze.
units.actual_scale: 75-person five-visit cohort; three overlapping masks each hide 54/269 observed follow-up PFS cells; 20 imputations per method/mask; 31 native gaps preserved.
units.comparison: Agent joint longitudinal imputer versus MICE–PMM versus missing-only; expanded 35-analysis replay.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Agent imputer improves hidden-cell accuracy and primary coefficient recovery relative to this MICE reference while preserving existing observations and all affected evidence states.
units.numeric_support: Cell MAE Agent 0.338457/0.327963/0.393704 vs MICE 0.362037/0.382223/0.471975. Primary coefficient mean error Agent 0.044560 vs MICE 0.087097. Affected evidence-state agreement Agent 18/18, MICE 17/18, missing-only 18/18.
units.counterresults: Missing-only primary error 0.010656, better in 3/3 masks. Agent improves effect discrepancy over missing-only 6/18. 29/35 unchanged outputs are preservation controls. Post-hoc weight influence check does not reverse main conclusion.
units.inference_scope: One cohort, one Agent model; unequal features/specifications prevent isolating LLM benefit; no demonstrated external-evidence gain or calibrated MI coverage.
units.paper_role: Useful completion and exact preservation claim; primary utility negative versus no filling must accompany it.

units.input_setting: Supplied moments from Ross/Travers/He; matched ordinary versus expanded scenario revisions; fixed statistical references.

units.input_setting: M7 joint TG literature gap; M9 insulin/HbA1c eligibility/evidence packets; M14 body-fat measurement/transport sources.

units.input_setting: Observed age/sex/BMI and external joint Tromso ratios; source-only construction; withheld fasting TG.

units.input_setting: Age/sex/BMI/fasting glucose observed; external sources; insulin entirely withheld; no autonomous retrieval.

units.input_setting: Inherited M10 families; source median shifts from SHIP scenarios; target age/sex/BMI only.

units.input_setting: Twenty supplied moments from one Bogalusa paper; four urate SDs withheld; all age/BMI/urate/race/sex fictional.

units.input_setting: Real fixed age/sex/race/BMI rows; three originals/two recruitment populations plus supplements and assisted retrieval; urate wholly withheld.

units.paper_role: Selected literal-data analytical feasibility with clear failure boundary.

units.input_setting: Same200 target covariate records and external originals; declared working guide frozen before literal outcomes; no urate answers.

units.input_setting: Three external publication populations plus prospective age×sex quota; no individual source or target rows and no target means/coefficients.
